findings.evidence: isAdmin trusts the client-controlled x-admin header, allowing unauthorized admin access without verified identity.
webhookOk compares only an 8-hex-char HMAC prefix and not in constant time, so forged signatures can be accepted.
invoiceQuery concatenates untrusted tenantId and invoiceId into SQL, enabling query manipulation.
overLimit returns false when requestCount is 6, so the sixth request in a window is not blocked as required.
